body.name: K_n
body.def: \(K_n=\{t\in[0,1]^2:\operatorname{pv}_n(t)>\alpha\}\), where \(\operatorname{pv}_n(t)=\min\{1,\beta_n+\sup_{q\in C_n:\,t\in\mathcal T(q)}P_q[\Delta_n^{\mathrm{rep}}(t)\ge\Delta_n^{\mathrm{obs}}(t)]\}\); here \(\mathcal T=\mathcal T_A\) or \(\mathcal T_B\), and the supremum over an empty set is zero.
body.role: Berger--Boos calibrated confidence-fiber inversion for PN/PS
